name: LatentTools orthogonal combine
plain: Splits the guidance adjustment into the part along the cond prediction and the part orthogonal to it, keeping the orthogonal part in full. Similar to APG with no momentum, but with an extra alternate-prediction term that can be included in or left out of the projection.
math:
b=x̂_c, û=b/‖b‖₂ over C,H,W. a=max(s−1,0)(x̂_c−x̂_u). e=w(alt_ref−alt), 0 when absent.
Included: t=a+e; x̂=b+t⊥+(1−f)t∥.
Excluded: x̂=b+a⊥+(1−f)a∥+e.
